item.title: Rani Abbakka Queen of Ullala - 500th birth anniversary
item.description: Rani Abbakka Queen of Ullala - 500th birth anniversary Rani Abbakka chowta, the queen of Ullala is one of the bravest warriors in Indian history. She is known for her fearless resistance against the Portuguese colonial power and for her unmatched courage and patriotism. Her life story stands as an inspiring example of bravery, leadership and love for motherland.
